sensor: Visible: 1/2.8" CMOS; Thermal: vanadium-oxide uncooled focal-plane microbolometer
features: high/low temperature alarm with buzzer and light linkage
thermal detection range up to 550m (60mm lens)
14 pseudo-colour palettes (White Hot, Black Hot, Iron Red, Rainbow, etc.)
release_notes: Specs per official Sparsh datasheet (SC-IT6420-HB V2, Rev 1.5). Dual-sensor thermal + visible camera; the datasheet covers three thermal sensor variants (256/384/640). Visible-light stream is 1080p (2MP); thermal video compression is H.264. No NDAA claim on this datasheet. Thermal lens/FOV vary by variant, so field_of_view_deg is omitted.

frigate.notes: Sparsh does not publish the RTSP path; discover via ONVIF. Default ONVIF/HTTP port 80, RTSP port 554. Thermal and visible streams are separate ONVIF profiles.

home_assistant.notes: Use the ONVIF integration; default ONVIF port 80. Camera exposes ONVIF Profile S.

blue_iris.notes: Add as a generic ONVIF camera.
